reserveReview.rationale: Saturn's PYUSDx-backed MultiMint implementation replaced the former M reserve. At finalized Ethereum block 26285088 (2026-10-27T15:57:11Z), pyusdx() returned 0xebdb0942ce16386ab90718c7bd10c91cdb66b14d; the proxy held 112,631,890.386495 PYUSDx against exactly 112,631,890.386495 USDat Ethereum totalSupply. M0 documents PYUSDx as MoonPay's PayPal USD-backed extension. The canonical PYUSD wrapper dependency is retained with the immediate PYUSDx claim annotated; no separate tracked PYUSDx identity or independent reserve-solvency assurance is inferred.
